card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of a longer word that is broken into parts, often a drug name or medical term, such as the b in thrombocytopenia or vec in vecuronium. The next piece completes the word.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: A piece inside a split medical or drug name, with the rest of the word still to come.

modes.label: Inside brand names and other words
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a capitalized brand name or an unusual word, such as TZIELD or sluggishly.
